title: coffee compartment
text: coffee compartment. I bought this for the family to use with our coffee machine.  I sit it behind and has ample storage for the to-go cups and lids, creamers, stirrers and sweetners.  It does take a fair amount of counter space, but it's all neat and tidy, so I think it's well worth it.  Would be great in an office too.  I purchased the black one and it looks great.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new information seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Mind Reader 6 Compartment Upright Breakroom Coffee Condiment and Cup Storage Organizer, Black, 13.5 x 4.30 x 12
features: 6 COMPARTMENTS: Equipped with 6 compartments, 3 on the top tier, and 3 on the bottom tier. Allows you to organize and store all of your coffee station and accessories needs. The ultimate breakroom organizer that also works well in the kitchen.

3 BOTTOM COMPARTMENTS: The 3 bottom tier compartments are ideal for storing creamer, tea packets, sugar, sweeteners, coffee pods, stirrers and more. The 3 generous size compartments allow you to fit a large amount of condiments and breakroom accessories.

3 TOP COMPARTMENTS: The 3 top tier compartments are great for storing and organizing coffee cups and lids. Can also hold plastic cups for cold beverages. The 3 generous size compartments keeps your cups and lids in one location making it convenient for you to make your favorite cup of Joe in the morning.

ULTIMATE COFFEE TEA CONDIMENT ORGANIZER FIXTURE: Complete serving essential holder, condiment, beverage accessories and snack organizing solution - perfect for any size office, coffee breakroom space or anywhere employees gather to eat and drink at work.
NO ASSEMBLY REQUIRED-RACK MEASUREMENTS: Food safe condiment rack caddy: 4.30" L x 13.5" W x 12" H

VERSATILE ORGANIZER SPACESAVER: multi-compartment organizer helps to keep loose condiments, ketchup and mustard packets, paper clips, thumb tacks, rubber bands and anything that needs organizing in their place until you're ready to use them - keep near coffee and hot water machines.

LIGHTWEIGHT AND DURABLE: durable constructions is food safe and easy to situate in the perfect spot on work counter, kitchen counter, table top or desk - can withstand day to day use of office employees, warehouse staff, hotel patrons and more.

KITCHEN COUNTERTOP ORGANIZER: All kitchens need organizing and this is a sure way to organize those coffee pods - keep on counter or hide away in kitchen cabinets if you've got the space and like things tucked away behind cabinet doors.
EASY TO CLEAN: Keeping organizers is easy - simply wipe clean with hot water and cleaning product to reduce dirt - keeping supplies off the counter is cleaner and healthier for everyone using them.

THE PERFECT CUP ORGANIZER: A great way to keep your coffee cups and lids organized in one location. Easily stack foam or plastic cups in this condiment organizer rack. Can hold solo cups and all other standard cup brands as well. Fits 10 oz, 12 oz, and 16 oz, cups comfortably in the top tier cup compartments.
description: This one piece Black coffee condiment organizer is made from a tough and safe plastic that will stand the test of time. This unit has 6 compartments that is a necessity for any Breakroom or kitchen. Imagine making your morning cup a Joe and everything you need is at your fingertips? Material PP.
